verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.viam.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Viam summary. Viam also publishes a dedicated agent-oriented guide, "use Viam from an agent", with concrete operating instructions for agents (list ResourceNames, check GetMachineStatus, plan motion via the motion service). Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and evidence of richer agent-doc formats such as a full-content llms file or per-page markdown.
